$comment: What npm run blender:build makes. parts: small attachments (category part, no LODs, origin = attach point). models: whole assets (category + heightMeters + placeholder as for any manifest entry; optimized with LODs into public/assets/blender/). builders live in builders.py.

parts.prompt: Lumen crystal cluster, large: nine faceted cyan crystals fanning out of a low dark rock base (Blender, crystal_cluster seed 3). Grows along +Y from its base.
Lumen crystal cluster, small: five faceted cyan crystals on a low dark base (Blender, crystal_cluster seed 7). Grows along +Y from its base.
Lumen crystal shard: one faceted cyan crystal, five-sided, slightly leaning (Blender, crystal_shard seed 11). Grows along +Y from its base.
